summary: Phase 3 implementation is correct and architecturally sound. All 7 decisions from phase-3-decisions.md are faithfully implemented. The shared contract lives in packages/domain/src/games/ (not in route handlers). calculateGameXP matches Decision 3.3 formula exactly. recordGameCompletion implements fire-once logic with SELECT-before-INSERT on xpLogs. completeRoute.ts validates via GameCompletionInputSchema and returns mock response with server-computed XP. HauntedLibraryGame.tsx onComplete payload matches the contract (no xp field, has idempotencyKey UUID). All targeted tests pass (20 domain + 7 route + 12 component). Full domain suite: 394 passed, 5 skipped. Lint and check-types clean on both packages.

nonblocking_findings.description: The completeRoute.test.ts 'does not call a real DB insert' positive control (test 7) only asserts response.status === 200 — it does not verify absence of a db parameter or mock a db spy. The assertion is structurally true (the function signature has no db param) but the test itself is a weak proof of mock honesty.
nonblocking_findings.recommendation: Consider adding a jest spy on any potential db import or asserting the function only uses schema + calculateGameXP. Low priority — the structural proof (no db in signature) is sufficient for Phase 3.

nonblocking_findings.description: The generateIdempotencyKey fallback in HauntedLibraryGame.tsx uses Math.random() which is not cryptographically strong. In production browsers, crypto.randomUUID() is used. This fallback exists only for older test runtimes.
nonblocking_findings.recommendation: Acceptable for Phase 3 standalone scope. If host app import (Phase 5) requires crypto-strong keys in all environments, consider using the Web Crypto API polyfill or generating the key server-side.

Formula: if totalAttempts===0 return 0; base=correctAnswers; bonus=(accuracy===1?2:0)+(victory?1:0)+(duration<60000?1:0); return Math.min(10,base+bonus). Test 'caps XP at 10 for perfect session': correctAnswers=10, totalAttempts=10, accuracy=1, victory=true, duration=30000 → XP=10. Test 'base XP only': correctAnswers=5, totalAttempts=10, accuracy=0.5, victory=false, duration=90000 → XP=5. Test 'zero attempts': XP=0. Test 'victory bonus': correctAnswers=5, totalAttempts=10, accuracy=0.5, victory=true, duration=90000 → XP=6. Test 'speed bonus': correctAnswers=5, totalAttempts=5, accuracy=1, victory=false, duration=30000 → XP=8.

Function calls assertCan(user,'games:complete',tenant) first. Re-validates input via gameCompletionInputSchema.parse (strict defense). Computes XP via calculateGameXP. SELECTs xpLogs by (userId, activityId) where activityId=game:<gameType>:<idempotencyKey>. If exists: returns {duplicate:true, xpEarned:0}. If not: INSERTs and returns {duplicate:false, xpEarned}. db.insert called exactly 1 across first+second call pair. Uses db.unscoped('xpLogs is REFERENTIAL') correctly.

evidence.detail: createCompleteRoute() POST: calls gameCompletionInputSchema.safeParse(body). On failure: returns 400 with Zod issues. On success: computes xpEarned via calculateGameXP, builds activityId=game:<gameType>:<idempotencyKey>, returns {xpEarned, activityId, duplicate:false, status:200}. No db call. Dynamic config is 'force-static'. 7/7 tests pass.

onComplete sends {gameType:'haunted-library', difficulty, score, accuracy, correctAnswers, totalAttempts, duration, victory, idempotencyKey, clientTimestamp}. No 'xp' field. idempotencyKey generated once via useRef (crypto.randomUUID with Math.random fallback). onComplete fires exactly once per game-over (B30-002 defense). Page.tsx handleComplete receives contract shape and POSTs to /api/v1/games/haunted-library/complete. 12/12 tests pass.
